register.labelZh: ZOOM 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: zoom in 和 zoom out 能幫助你準確描述相機、相片、地圖或屏幕畫面的變化。；這些表達常見於攝影、視像通話、地圖應用程式和相片編輯工具。；認識 zoom in 和 zoom out，有助你理解電影、新聞報道和體育重播如何引導觀眾留意不同細節。；zoom off 能讓你生動直接地描述汽車、電單車或其他交通工具迅速離開。
register.summaryEn: Zoom in and zoom out help you explain exactly how a camera, photograph, map or screen view changes. These expressions often appear in photography, video calls, map applications and photo-editing tools. Knowing zoom in and zoom out helps you understand how films, news reports and sports replays direct your attention. Zoom off gives you a lively and direct way to describe a car, motorbike or other vehicle leaving quickly.
